## Where I am
Work sits on branch `daniel/saml-sso-fernhill`. JIT provisioning (PR #415) and SAML assertion validation are merged. Real login against Fernhill's staging ADFS now succeeds after implementing a Redis-backed short opaque RelayState token to bypass their 80-byte limit. Group-to-role mapping is coded and staged in PR #421. We are blocked until Fernhill IT exposes the `groups` claim in their IdP response ahead of Thursday’s demo. (source: ses-sso-3, src-linear-kes311)

- [en-cours] Group-to-role mapping implementation and staging verification. Fernhill IT must activate the `groups` claim so admin/analyst roles apply correctly during login. (source: ses-sso-3)
- [prochaine-étape] Run live SSO demo with Fernhill IT on Thursday 10:00 NY time. Merge PR #421 after acceptance. Enforce SSO/disabled password login for the fernhill tenant by Dec 1. (source: s3-10, src-note-enforce)
- [essai-raté] Truncating the full return URL to fit the 80-byte RelayState cap. Caused broken deep links on their ADFS. Switched to server-side Redis storage with a 16-byte base64url ID instead. (source: ses-sso-3)
- [décision] Keep the default role as `viewer` and retain SP-initiated login for this tenant, rather than switching to `analyst` or IdP-initiated only. (source: s3-07)
